author: XBOX
description:
On this episode of the Official XBOX Podcast, we're sitting down with the team behind the upcoming Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy to discuss the setting, the story, the combat, and how the team was able to design a game that fits wonderfully into the Plague Tale series but is presented in a whole new way.

0:00 Intro
1:04 Meet Sophia
2:57 Trailer Reveal Breakdown and Greek Mythology
5:40 New Combat Style in the Series
6:48 Combat Style Details
8:56 Risk and Reward in Combat, and the New Skill Tree
11:42 World Building and the Plague Tale style
13:26 Title Inspiration
14:40 Closing Thoughts

description:
Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

Coming to XBOX Game Pass, XBOX Series X|S, and XBOX One on September 22, 2026.
